title: PlatformEDL
description: The frame-accurate child timeline for ONE platform, objective, duration, locale, and aspect treatment (PRD REQ-050). Derived from a MasterStoryPlan; a distinct EDL per requested platform (REQ-050). Every clip carries an exact `SourceRange` validated by range-check.ts (the 'zero invalid source ranges' exit-criterion mechanism), the Moment it came from, its narrative role, and — where it captions speech — the quote provenance the D-37 quotation gate needs. Retains domain metadata OTIO cannot express: narrative role, hook hypothesis, platform objective, caption treatment, rationale (PRD §5.190). Immutable revision. The model PROPOSES ranges; deterministic `validate` code owns every blocking decision (D-37).

changelog.reason: Initial v1 (Phase 3, tech-spec §15 step 5). Caption entries carry a `quote` tagged union so a quoted caption always ships the verbatim source text + speaker it must be checked against — the D-37 quote gate tokenises the verbatim side, so a shortened display caption can never launder a misquote past it. `aspectTreatment` uses an enum with no centre_crop member (REQ-052). Disclosures + audioMode are present so the deterministic disclosure/rights gates have inputs.

Adds optional `clips[].transition` (D-52): duration-preserving video+audio fades only - `fadeInMs`/`fadeOutMs`, 40-2000 ms, applied to the composited clip so the fade covers background fill and subject alike. Adjacent fadeOut+fadeIn reads as a dip-to-black join; a leading fadeIn / trailing fadeOut opens or closes the cut. Deliberately excluded and named in D-52: crossfades (overlap changes output duration and every caption cue time) and multi-window composition (needs a parallel-track timeline model; D-47's split_screen refusal stands). Absent or null means a hard cut - existing EDLs are untouched, so this is a compatible addition under the same major.

storyPlanId.description: The MasterStoryPlan this EDL renders for one platform (PRD lineage §3).

parentEdlId.description: The revision this supersedes, or null for the first (REQ-039).

platform.description: The single target platform (REQ-050). At Phase 0 only `tiktok` resolves to a capability fixture (D-3); `plan` fails explicitly on any other.

targetDurationRange.title: DurationRange
targetDurationRange.description: The output duration window this EDL targets (REQ-050). The capability gate checks it against the platform fixture's duration pin (D-3: 5–180 s for TikTok organic AU). maxSeconds >= minSeconds enforced in the resolver, not schema (§3 forbids if/then/else).

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.description: The output frame (REQ-052). 9:16 720x1280 for TikTok organic AU (PRD §11 minResolution).

aspectRatio.description: Human-readable ratio, e.g. `9:16`. The resolver checks it against the platform fixture's preferredAspectRatios.

aspectTreatment.title: AspectTreatmentChoice
aspectTreatment.description: How the canvas is filled (REQ-052). The enum has no centre_crop member, so blind centre-cropping is unrepresentable; the rationale records why this treatment fits the footage.

hookFamily.description: Which hook hypothesis this cut opens with (carried down from the CreativeBrief/plan for A/B provenance).

clips.description: The ordered timeline. Each clip is one Moment-derived source range placed on the child timeline, in intended play order. `sourceRange` is validated against the asset's preflighted duration by range-check.ts — the single bounds validator, reused here exactly as `index` uses it over Moments.

order.description: Play position; the resolver asserts a contiguous permutation.

momentId.description: The Moment this clip realises. Rights, speakers, and verbatim transcript for the quote/rights gates are read from this Moment.

assetId.description: The SourceAsset the range indexes into. Must equal the Moment's assetId and the sourceRange.assetId; the resolver checks all three agree.

sourceRange.description: The exact half-open range into the source. Validated by range-check.ts against the asset's preflighted duration — an out-of-bounds range is a NON-WAIVABLE block (D-35/D-37), never clamped.

caption.title: ClipCaption
caption.description: The editorial caption decision for this clip (the render is Phase 4; the DECISION and its quote provenance live here). A tagged union so a clip with no caption, a text-led caption, and a spoken-quote caption are distinct — the quote variant always carries the verbatim source text + speaker the D-37 gate checks against.

displayText.description: Author-written on-screen text that does not quote speech (a title, a promise). Checked against JobBrief prohibited claims like any other text.

The caption as shown, possibly shortened. The D-37 gate requires its quoted tokens to be an in-order subsequence of `verbatimSourceText` — a shortening that reorders or interpolates meaning is blocked (REQ-037).

verbatimSourceText.description: The exact spoken words from the Moment transcript this caption quotes. The resolver checks it matches the referenced Moment's verbatim transcript.

speakerLabel.description: Who is quoted. The gate checks it against the Moment's speakers[].label; an UNCORRECTED speaker label is an unverified identity the critic flags.

oneOf.title: ClipTransition

fadeInMs.description: Fade from black (video) and silence (audio) over this many milliseconds at the clip's head. Duration-preserving: the clip occupies exactly the same output frames as a hard cut.

fadeOutMs.description: Fade to black/silence over this many milliseconds at the clip's tail. Paired with the next clip's fadeInMs it reads as a dip-to-black join.

oneOf.description: Both fields optional; an empty object is a hard cut. The renderer refuses a pair whose sum exceeds the clip's duration (FADE_LONGER_THAN_CLIP) rather than layering fades over each other.

transition.description: The editorial transition decision for this clip's boundaries (D-52). Optional and null-safe so every pre-existing EDL remains valid; absent means hard cut. Fades are the only Phase 0 vocabulary - duration-preserving by design, so caption cue times and QA duration math are unaffected. A fade still changes the EDL and its content hashes like any other edit decision; what stays invariant is the draft-to-final plan-hash chain, since both tiers render the same faded EDL.

audioMode.description: REQ-056 audio-rights mode. A `cross_platform_cleared` or `byo_licensed` mode requires the rights gate to find recorded evidence; `native_audio_plan` defers the track to native publishing.

disclosures.title: Disclosures
disclosures.description: Platform disclosure flags (REQ-058). The deterministic disclosure gate requires a paid-partnership disclosure when distributionMode is `paid`, and an AI-media disclosure when the edit materially alters media — a missing required disclosure is a NON-WAIVABLE block (D-35).

paidPartnership.description: Whether this output discloses a paid partnership.

aiGeneratedOrAltered.description: Whether AI-generated or materially altered media is disclosed (maps to TikTok `is_aigc`, PRD §11).

metadata.title: EdlMetadata
metadata.description: Minimal search/publishing metadata (REQ-050 'metadata'; REQ-054 full package is Phase 1). Title and optional description are checked against JobBrief prohibited claims like any other text.

coverFrame.title: CoverFrame
coverFrame.description: The chosen cover / validated first frame (REQ-055), or an explicit none. Tagged union so 'no cover chosen yet' and 'this Moment at this instant' are distinct.

atTick.description: The instant within the source the cover frame is taken from. Validated against the asset's bounds like any other range endpoint.
